title: Designing Clinical Research
text:
Course Overview
This live educational event is a structured continuing medical education program designed to equip healthcare professionals with the essential knowledge and practical skills required to design, conduct, analyze, and report high-quality medical research in accordance with international ethical and scientific standards.
The course emphasizes evidence-based medicine, research integrity, and methodological rigor, supporting participants in translating research findings into improved clinical practice and healthcare outcomes.

Intended target audience
Physicians, , other Healthcare Professionals, and undergraduates with an interest in clinical research.
This course is intended for:

Medical doctors and specialists
Residents and postgraduate trainees
Academic clinicians and clinical educators
Healthcare professionals involved in research activities including dentists, pharmacists, nurses .. etc
Public health professionals and allied healthcare researchers
undergraduates with an interest in clinical research

title: Designing Clinical Research
text:
Educational Need and Rationale
Healthcare professionals are increasingly required to:

Interpret and apply research evidence in clinical decision-making
Participate in clinical and translational research
Publish in peer-reviewed journals
Comply with ethical, regulatory, and governance standards

This course addresses identified gaps in research methodology, critical appraisal, data analysis, and scientific communication, in line with international principles for continuing professional development.

Intended Learning Outcomes

Formulate clinically relevant research questions using appropriate frameworks
Select and justify suitable study designs for medical research
Apply principles of research ethics, governance, and regulatory compliance
Perform basic statistical analyses and interpret research data
Critically appraise medical literature and systematic reviews
Prepare research protocols, abstracts, and manuscripts for publication



Career outcomes
Trainees can explore various career paths in medical research, clinical trials, and healthcare services. Potential roles include research scientist, clinical researcher, or positions within pharmaceutical companies and academic institutions. We will prepare trainees for both further study and professional practice in medical research-related fields.

Core principles of our educational activities

Academic independence

The program is free from commercial bias
Development of curricula, design of scientific event programs, and selection of faculty are the sole responsibilities of course director.
Planning of this live educational event is based on needs assessment data.
Industry participation is NOT allowed during the entire curriculum development and planning process, to ensure academic independence and keep content free from bias.

Compliance to accreditation codes

Planning, organization, and execution of this live educational event follow and comply with existing codes for accreditation of high-quality CME activities.

Branding and advertising

No industry logos or advertising are permitted in association with education and in the area where educational activities take place.
No pharmaceutical or medical device company influences content or faculty selection
Industry staff are not allowed to interfere with the educational content or engage in educational activities during the event.

Transparency

All relevant information is disclosed to the learners so that they fully understand how the content has been developed and presented. This includes conflict of interest disclosures of faculty involved in the development and delivery of the scientific content
